rationale: Fix-up commit 5efea489f directly resolves CR-001: Conversation.find_by_id() and .update() are now inside the same try/except Exception -> logger.error(exc_info=True) block used for generate_name, so a persistence failure no-ops exactly like every other failure mode, matching the spec's Error handling contract. Two new tests (test_rename_conversation_swallows_exception_from_find_by_id, test_rename_conversation_swallows_exception_from_update) confirm the exception is swallowed and no longer propagates. Doc wording for the background_task=True known limitation was also corrected from 'may not reliably' to an accurate description of the guaranteed no-fire behavior, addressing the secondary rationale note from the final round. No new high-risk issue introduced by this small, contained fix-up diff.
